text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I came to visit the injured <chrname>,
there was a figure in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Here goes, Sasami! 
I'll fix up that injury with a good poke in no time!
choice_data_list: What are you planning to do?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
A treatment, of course!
A precious Umamusume is in a pinch!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: If an acupuncturist doesn't stick needles into people, who will?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I've even studied secret pressure points that work wonders on injuries!
Please, please, let me try them out on you~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to do everything I can
for <chrname>'s sake.
...Still, leaving it all up to her makes me uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You seem to be misunderstanding something.
It's not that I... want to perform the procedure.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
As the one and only bamboo needle acupuncturist...
I must protect the future of Umamusume!
choice_data_list: To care that deeply about Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
If that future comes about with a clean stab,
it'd be totally awesome...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Leave the rest to me.
No entry during the procedure...!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: —Since I'm here, I'm totally gonna try all sorts of stuff~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Bang bang! Clang clang! Vroooom!)
(VRRRROOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, absolutely incredible!
You're in better shape than before your injury... how?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Got a little panicked when I hit the wrong pressure point, though! Wow, I'm such a genius~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she predicted, <chrname> powered up
and made a full, triumphant comeback!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
It went without a hitch!
I guess information from Umatter actually can be pretty useful...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and while I was at it, I gave your pressure points
a good jab to boost your physical stats☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she predicted, <chrname> grew stronger
and returned from her injury!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm, something just doesn't feel right~.
Like I'm not getting proper feedback from it...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that happens sometimes!
I'll leave the rest to you~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The state of the injury hadn't changed...
Still, let's just be thankful that <chrname> is safe.
